# CLAS12 preliminary neutron DVCS unpolarized cross sections
# Source: "Measurement of Deeply Virtual Compton Scattering Cross-Section on the Neutron at the CLAS12 Experiment"
# Analysis note version 0.0, April 22, 2026; Tables A.1-A.9.
#
# Reaction: e n -> e n gamma, extracted from liquid-deuterium RGA data.
# The table values below are the mean kinematics and unpolarized cross sections
# quoted in the note.  The first quoted uncertainty is statistical and the
# second is systematic.
#
# Cross-section units in the note: pb/GeV^4.
# Convenience nb/GeV^4 columns are also included for direct use with the
# existing Gepard-based analysis machinery.
#
# The note combines data taken at several beam energies and quotes an average
# beam energy of about 10.45 GeV.  The neutron analysis mode therefore uses
# Ebeam = 10.45 GeV by default.
#
# IMPORTANT PRELIMINARY-ANALYSIS CAVEATS:
# - The note states that radiative corrections were still under development and
#   were not yet included in this iteration.
# - The bin-integral/bin-centering correction is obtained from a Bethe-Heitler
#   calculation because BH is expected to dominate much of the kinematics.
# - The published table gives a total per-point systematic uncertainty but does
#   not provide a covariance matrix or a clean correlated/point-to-point split.
#   The exploratory neutron-radius mode therefore treats the quoted systematic
#   uncertainty point-by-point and does not invent an additional normalization
#   nuisance.
#
